findings.summary: services root owns too many unrelated capabilities
routes mix transport and query execution collaborators
Neo4j and LangGraph execution share one flat package
two EvaluationService and two baseline families
duplicate Settings field and unconsumed optimized_config

waves.goal: freeze ownership, contracts, imports, dynamic loads and compatibility map
remove same-stem collisions and clarify config/evaluation owners
converge core, domain, API schemas and model runtime
organize graph, ingestion, retrievers, evaluation and tools
organize API application, deps, query internals and route groups
converge pipeline, orchestration, MCP and legacy workflow boundaries
exports, compatibility retirement, documentation and verification

constraints: preserve public imports with import-only wrappers
do not change retrieval, model or workflow behavior during moves
delete only after app/scripts/tests/docs/config audit and removal-register evidence
never create another same-stem .py file and package pair
